   /// R1868000: the card as a play at these prices declares its choices — its embiggen stamped and the
   /// X the play is for, as §10.5 step 1 stamps them, so a declaration's named check reads the play's X
   /// (`tuning::x_of`; Stinkyscape #99 No-No Words). A set X (R1848003) is on the card already.
   fn stamped_for_play(state: &GameState, card: &CardInstance, x: Option<i32>, embiggen: Option<bool>) -> CardInstance {
       CardInstance {
           x: if chooses_x(state, card) { Some(x.unwrap_or(0)) } else { card.x },
           ..stamped_with_embiggen(state, card, embiggen)
       }
   }
   ```

     - A declaration's named check is asked of the card with the play's X stamped (or its set X), so `legalActions` pairs each X with the picks it allows, and §10.5 step 1 refuses any other.
     - "Less than 4X" means strictly below `per` × X, Attack as shown.
     - X = 0 is no play (R348).
     - The pick is not required (R703), so with nothing below the limit the play fizzles (R90).
     - The check is not made again as the Spell resolves. Hearthstone checks a target's requirement when it is chosen: Shadow Word: Pain still destroys a Mana Wyrm that its own cast raised.
